newsitem.title: UK: BFI up 11 on good demand for Panamaxes.
newsitem.headline: BFI up 11 on good demand for Panamaxes.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) rose 11 points to 1,311 relflecting persistent demand from both grain and minerals charterers for early Panamaxes in the Atlantic and North Pacific, brokers said.
Grain charterers in the Atalntic were increasingly resorting to timecharter instead of voyage terms and a number of deals were concluded privately.
Short period enquiry in the Pacific has continued with Sinotrans reported to have taken North Princess 71,200 dwt delivery South China early July for three to five months at a firmer $10,200 daily.
At 12.00 GMT BIFFEX was trading at 15 to five points higher and turnover was 66 lots.
